item.title: Push for 'Invest in Our New York' tax hikes on Tin Cup Day
item.description: Advocates, activists, and elected officials gathered at the New York State Capitol to demand higher taxes on the state's wealthiest residents and corporations to generate billions to protect childcare and healthcare from federal budget cuts.

item.title: Drivers face license suspension for single alcohol or drug violation
item.description: New York drivers face stricter penalties and a higher likelihood of license suspension starting February 16 due to new DMV regulations, with alcohol- and drug-related convictions now worth points on their license.

item.title: Lawmakers propose $175 million for Lake Champlain through 2032
item.description: New York lawmakers from both parties have introduced a federal bill to extend the Lake Champlain Basin Program through 2032, earmarking $35 million a year for water quality improvements, invasive species control, and pollution reduction across the border with Vermont.

item.title: Rome Police seeking information on fatal pedestrian accident
item.description: Rome Police are looking for the driver of a car that was involved in an accident earlier this month in which one person is now dead.

item.title: Home care workers, lawmakers want transparency on $11B CDPAP operator PPL
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for transparency from Public Partnerships LLC, the company running the state's Medicaid home care system, after 150,000 workers and 90,000 patients left the program due to missing paychecks and benefits.
